# Assets · Flags

8 files under `assets/Flags/`, held in the artifact’s asset store: fetch one with the Artifact tool’s `read`, the id below as `path` (they are not files beside the page — a read by file path fails), then upload it to your own artifact as an asset (`publish`, `asset:true`; or `upload_asset`, where your tool lists that); an SVG may also be inlined. Copy assets, never approximate them.

## Use

```html
<img src="<the url the asset upload returned for de.svg>" alt="…">
```

## Usage notes

# Flags

Round-cropped SVG flags used on node tabs, cards, tunnels and the Tor and PIA windows. SVG because Windows does not render flag emoji. Ship only the flags in use as one sprite.
